evidence: The source material for indium was indium acetylacetonate (In(CH3COCHCOCH3)3), In(acac)3, (98%, Strem Chemicals). Hydrogen sulfide, H2S (99.5%, Messer) and O2 (99.9995%, Messer) were used as respectively sulfur and oxygen sources. O2 was introduced in a remote RF plasma generator with Argon (99.9997%, Messer) as carrier gas, and plasma power was set at 2600 W (Section 3.1) or varied in the 300 W - 2600 W range (Sections 3.2 and 3.3). The carrier and purge gas was nitrogen with a purity of 99.9999% (Messer).
